comparison.objective: Intercept a rolling item before an end line and pack it; candidate tunes a damper through repeated test impacts.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed interception, capture and packing versus small-tool alignment, collar rotation, locking and response-guided iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Item caught before the line and packed versus two non-bottoming, non-rebounding stops with no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Shared moving-object timing is incidental; interception and packing do not test adjustment of a retained damping mechanism. Setup, scoring and timing thresholds are absent.
